summary: No evidence of installer-side harm in preferenceslifecycle-paypal@24.0.0
details: No malicious behavior was identified in this package version. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote code, no credential or environment scraping, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, and no silent-relay or backdoor mechanisms were observed. The package name resembles unrelated PayPal-adjacent terms, but name resemblance alone is not a supply-chain threat.
